fields.name: claim_id
fields.description: Unique identifier assigned to the insurance claim.

fields.name: policy_number
fields.description: Insurance policy number under which the claim is filed.

fields.name: claimant_name
fields.description: Name of the person making the claim or the patient’s name.

fields.name: provider_name
fields.description: Healthcare provider or facility that rendered services.

fields.name: service_date_range
fields.description: Date(s) when medical services were performed.

fields.name: diagnosis_codes
fields.description: ICD or DSM codes describing the patient’s diagnosis.

fields.name: procedure_codes
fields.description: CPT or HCPCS codes for services provided.

fields.name: amount_billed
fields.description: Total amount billed for the services.

fields.name: amount_covered
fields.description: Portion of the amount that insurance covers.

fields.name: patient_responsibility
fields.description: Remaining amount the patient must pay out of pocket.

fields.name: claim_status
fields.description: Current status of the claim (e.g., pending, approved, denied).

fields.name: submission_date
fields.description: Date the claim was submitted to the insurer.

document.document_description: Insurance claim documents are used by policyholders or healthcare providers to request reimbursement or payment from an insurer for healthcare services rendered, often including patient details, coverage information, and itemized charges.
